proposals.evidence: DEDR3738 gives Malayalam neṭuppam length and neṭukkam tallness, Tamil neṭiyoṉ tall person, Telugu niḍuda long, and Konda niṟi long/niṟikan tall man. These neḍuppam/neḍukkam/naḍiya/naḍiyatɨ and Konda nirika survey responses match the documented long/tall family with ordinary adjective endings and source vowel notation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey cīva/cīval/civil/cīvalu-type broom nouns are proposed southern lect extensions of the sweep/broom family with ordinary nominal endings and source vowels retained. Longer bundle compounds are analysed separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
